title: "LM_testing"
output: html_document
---

We won't be able to directly use LM when we have both censored and uncensored subjects because it builds the model as if it is over all subjects and I don't think it would make sense to split the censored/uncensored or subject-level GLMs when we have one big model.

```{r}
library(nimble)
library(nimbleMacros)


```

# built model
```{r}

code <- nimbleCode({
  LM(y[1:N] ~ x[1:N], family = poisson())
})


set.seed(1)

N <- 10

constants <- list(
  N = N,
  x = rnorm(N)
)

data <- list(
  y = rnorm(N)
)

model <- nimbleModel(
  code = code,
  constants = list(N = N, x = rnorm(N)),
  data = list(y = rpois(N,2))
)

model$getCode()
```
